user.title: Add a new hamster
user.description: Let's start with some basic information about your hamster.

data_description.hamster_name: The name of your hamster. Used as the device name.
data_description.acquisition_date: The date your hamster moved in with you.
data_description.breed: Purely descriptive - it shows up on the cards and never affects the health score.
data_description.breed_other: Only used when the breed above is set to "Other" - e.g. a mix or a breed missing from the list.
data_description.coat_color: Tints the illustrated hamster on the dashboard cards. Pick whichever comes closest.
data_description.wheel_diameter: Diameter of the running wheel, as usually stated on the packaging or product page. If you're also using an ESPHome device for the wheel sensor, enter the same value there too.

sensors.title: Select source sensors
sensors.description: Choose the existing sensors and notification targets that should feed this hamster's device.

data_description.wheel_sensor: A sensor whose numeric state represents wheel rotations (e.g. a counter or pulse sensor) - a raw count that only ever increases, never a distance already converted to km. Using the bundled ESPHome firmware? Pick 'Hamster Wheel Total Rotations' - type 'Hamster Wheel' to narrow the list.
data_description.wheel_diameter_sync_entity: A number entity that should always match the wheel diameter entered above - typically the 'Hamster Wheel Diameter' entity on an ESPHome device. Whenever the diameter is set here (now or later, via Reconfigure), it's automatically pushed to this entity too, so you don't have to update both by hand. Leave empty to keep them fully independent.
data_description.temperature_sensor: A temperature sensor (device_class: temperature) placed near the cage.
data_description.door_sensor: A binary sensor (device_class: door or opening) that detects when the cage or lid is opened. Leave empty if you don't have one - no Care pillar or cage-door entity will be created, and the Sleep pillar tracks activity only.
data_description.humidity_sensor: A humidity sensor (device_class: humidity) placed near the cage. Leave empty if you don't have one - no humidity entity will be created.
data_description.speed_sensor: A sensor reporting the current, real-time wheel speed (device_class: speed). Using the bundled ESPHome firmware? Pick 'Hamster Wheel Speed'. Leave empty if you don't have one - no speed entities will be created.
data_description.light_entity: A light that should turn on when the cage/lid opens and (optionally) back off when it closes - brightness, transition and turn-off behavior are configurable below. Leave empty if you don't have one - no light automation is set up.
data_description.illuminance_sensor: A light sensor (device_class: illuminance) placed where your hamster actually lives. When set, the Day & Night card uses its reading for day/night instead of the sun's position - useful behind curtains, in a basement, or under a cover. Leave empty to keep using the sun.
data_description.weather_entity: A weather entity, used for two things: the optional heat care reminder, which looks at the day's forecast high, and the Day & Night card's weather overlay - cloud, rain, snow, fog and lightning drifting over the scene. Leave empty and both stay inactive.
data_description.moon_entity: A sensor reporting the current moon phase - typically 'sensor.moon' from Home Assistant's built-in Moon integration, which works out the phase locally, with no internet connection or extra hardware. When set, the Day & Night card draws the actual phase instead of a fixed crescent. There is no device class to filter this list on, so type 'moon' to narrow it down. Leave empty to keep the fixed crescent.
data_description.notify_services: Notify entities that should receive alerts and daily summaries.

error.invalid_name: Please enter a name for your hamster.
error.invalid_diameter: Wheel diameter must be greater than 0.
error.not_numeric: The selected wheel sensor's current state is not a number.
error.not_a_counter: That entity reports a live reading, not a running total. Pick the sensor that counts wheel rotations - with the bundled firmware it is named "Hamster Wheel Total Rotations". A speed or distance sensor will not work: the distances derived from it would be wrong.
error.entity_not_found: This entity could not be found. Please pick it again.
error.breed_required: Please name the breed, or pick one from the list instead of "Other".

abort.already_configured: A hamster with this name has already been configured.

init.title: Hamster Fitness settings
init.description: Fine-tune the health-score thresholds and the notifications.

data_description.ideal_temp_min: Lower bound of the ideal cage temperature range.
data_description.ideal_temp_max: Upper bound of the ideal cage temperature range.
data_description.min_distance_km: Below this distance run in a night, the health score drops sharply. Rated against the current night and the last completed one, whichever is higher - so the score never dips just because a new night has only started.
data_description.lifetime_distance_km: Only needed to correct the total - normally it looks after itself. Set this after replacing the wheel sensor, or if history was lost. The field always opens showing the current total, so saving it unchanged does nothing.

notification_settings.name: Notifications
notification_settings.description: Every notification Hamster Fitness can send, in one place - warnings, the daily summary, and the weigh-in and heat reminders. Collapsed by default; most of the time there is nothing to change here.

data.weight_reminder_enabled: Remind me to weigh the hamster

data_description.warnings_enabled: Turn off to silence immediate warnings (temperature, neglected cage, low score, too little exercise).
data_description.daily_summary_enabled: Turn off to stop the nightly distance summary.
data_description.notification_time: Local time at which the daily summary is sent.
data_description.weight_reminder_enabled: Only nags when the weight is actually overdue - if you enter a new value regularly, this reminder never fires. Sent at the daily summary time above.
data_description.weight_reminder_days: How many days may pass without a new weight before the reminder is sent.
data_description.heat_forecast_enabled: Sends a morning reminder when the day's forecast high reaches the threshold below - shade the cage, keep the room cool, refill the water more often. Needs a weather entity picked during setup; without one this does nothing.
data_description.heat_forecast_threshold_c: Forecast OUTDOOR high that triggers the reminder - not the cage temperature. The two don't map onto each other: air conditioning, a basement, or a north-facing room all change how much of the outside heat reaches the cage.

light_settings.name: Cage light
light_settings.description: Only takes effect if you picked a cage light in the sensors step. Collapsed by default, since most of the time there is nothing to change here.

data_description.light_brightness_pct: Brightness the light is set to when the cage opens.
data_description.light_transition_s: Fade duration for both turning on and off, in seconds. 0 switches instantly.
data_description.light_turn_off_enabled: Turn off automatically when the cage closes. Switch off if something else - an automation, say - should decide when the light goes out.
data_description.light_turn_off_delay_s: Only relevant with automatic turn-off enabled. Wait this many seconds after the cage closes before switching off. 0 turns it off immediately.

error.invalid_temp_range: The minimum temperature must be lower than the maximum.

warning.low_score: The health score has dropped to {score}%.
warning.too_little_exercise: Only {distance} km run so far, well below normal.
warning.underweight: At {weight} g, that's below the healthy range for this breed.
warning.overweight: At {weight} g, that's above the healthy range for this breed.
warning.neglected: The cage hasn't been opened in {hours} hours.

notify.weight_reminder: It's been {days} days since the last weigh-in.
notify.weight_reminder_never: No weight recorded yet - time for a first weigh-in?
notify.heat_forecast: Up to {temperature} °C forecast today. Give the cage shade, keep the room cool during the day, and refill the water more often so it doesn't spoil in the heat.

pause_light_automation.name: Pause light automation
pause_light_automation.description: Temporarily stops the cage-light automation from reacting to the cage door, then re-arms it by itself. Handy while cleaning the cage, so the light doesn't flick on and off with every lift of the lid.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: How long the automation stays paused. Calling this again replaces a running pause instead of stacking another one on top.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish the update
restart_required.description:
Hamster Fitness {installed_version} has been downloaded, but Home Assistant is still running {running_version} — the new code only takes effect after a restart.

Click **Fix** below to restart now, or go to **Settings → System → Restart** yourself. This notice disappears by itself once the restart is done.

confirm.description: This will restart Home Assistant now to finish loading Hamster Fitness {installed_version}. All other integrations and any running automations restart along with it.
